§ A3 · Track A

Writing a field twice

Repeating a field adds detail. The copies must agree, and a disagreement is an error.

Time
10 min
Needs
A2, a value can also be a type
You will learn
What happens when two values disagree? Why does the order of the lines not matter?
Done when
pravo eval prints one value for size and an error for the conflict.

View as Markdown

In OpenTofu, a variable has a default and an override. The override wins and nothing reports the difference. You run a plan, read the numbers, and find out later what changed.

Open an empty directory and run pravo init once. Then work through the steps below with the unification of values in mind. The word concrete is defined in the glossary.

The pain, in HCL

The module default is 30 days. The auto-loaded variables file sets 7. Plan output shows retention = 7 and no warning.

Pitfall

A later value replaces an earlier one without a message. Precedence rules decide the winner, and you have to remember them.

The idea

CUE has no override. A second retention field does not replace the first. It adds a requirement, and the result satisfies both.

Agreeing copies

Disagreeing copies

The next block carries the conflict badge before you run it. The error names the path, both values and both locations.

Predict What does pravo eval print when one copy says size: 3 and the other says size: int?

It prints size: 3. The type is less specific than the number, so the number is the result.

Shapes that reject a typo

A definition closes a shape. A field that the definition does not declare is refused before any provider starts.

Note

Run pravo eval after each edit. The output is the only evidence that counts.

Tip

Press / or Ctrl K to search this site.

Warning

A saved plan carries the tags it was made with. Apply it with the same tags.

Check

If pravo eval prints two locations, you wrote the field twice with different values.

Quick reference

GlyphMeaningExit codeExample
+The object is added0+ local_file.hello
~The object changes in place0~ local_file.motd
-/+The object is replaced0-/+ local_file.index

  • Lists use a hairline accent marker.
  • A second item with a link and strong text.
    • A nested item.
  1. Write the field once.
  2. Write it again with a different value.
  3. Read the error.

A conflict is an error, not an override.

Exercise

Clear the conflict

Delete the right line so that pravo eval prints retention: 30. Then write two partial structs for tags that merge into one.

Hint

Look at the two locations in the error. One of them is the line to delete.

Hint

Read unification in the glossary.

Solution
Why the order does not matter

Unification is commutative and associative. Any order of the same fields produces the same result.

Recap

  • A second field adds a requirement; it never replaces.
  • Agreeing copies produce one value.
  • Disagreeing copies produce an error with both locations.

Check yourself

What does size: 3 followed by size: 11 produce?

An error: size: conflicting values 11 and 3, with two locations.

Does swapping the two lines change the result?

No. The result and the error are the same.
